symptom: `alter published rest service M.BookingApi add operation delete '{id}' in resource 'bookings' …` was a parse error (mismatched input 'operation' expecting RESOURCE): there was no way to add one operation to a stored resource short of restating the whole service.
file: grammar MDLParser.g4 alterPublishedRestServiceAction (ADD OPERATION IN RESOURCE '…' { … } / DROP OPERATION <method> ['path'] IN RESOURCE '…'); visitor_rest.go buildPublishedRestOperationDef (shared with the resource block); cmd_published_rest.go execAlterPublishedRestService; check in validate_published_rest_ops.go publishedRestAlterResourceProblems. Test: mdl/executor/alter_published_rest_operation_2449_test.go; mdl-examples/bug-tests/2449-published-rest-add-operation.mdl
insight: **Reuse create's operation rule inside the alter, not a re-spelled one**: the resource block (`add operation in resource 'x' { <create's line>; }`) lets describe output be pasted into an add unchanged, and one visitor builder serves both, so they cannot drift. An operation is keyed resource+method+path exactly as the drop warning keys it.
